profile.headline: Advertising and Web Development in the 603
profile.summary:
I hold a Bachelor of Arts in Advertising with a focus on Account Management and Digital Media Technologies from Temple University. My professional journey has encompassed diverse roles in advertising, sales, marketing, hospitality, and web development over several years. These experiences have honed my skills in client relations, Salesforce integration, bartending, waitressing, and content creation across various industries. Each role has equipped me with the ability to adapt quickly and contribute effectively to dynamic environments.

At Temple University—an esteemed institution known for its commitment to educating future leaders—I am part of an organization that fosters learning and innovation on a global scale. With its top-tier research capabilities and expansive academic offerings across 17 schools and colleges serving nearly 40,000 students worldwide, Temple is dedicated to shaping impactful careers. Contact me if you want to learn more about our mission or explore opportunities for collaboration!

positions.title: Advertising Sales Representative
positions.description: Create New Company Website using WordPress, Implement features of new WordPress Website into Salesforce by using Salesforce Hootsuite Integration to Automate new website across company's Salesforce Database, Work with Marketing Department, Work with Sales Department, Travel to Company Trade Shows in the United States, Understand Company Products and Technologies, Sell company products and technology on websites and through growing potential customers at domestic B2B and B2C Trade Shows, Advertise Company Products and Technologies at Trade shows, on company website, and through company social media campaigns, Publish Blog Articles related to company's products and technologies, Use Google Business to promote Google Ad campaigns and CRM. Work at and understand other owner-owned companies; including a Solar Panel Company, an Industrial Air FIltration company, and a recently acquired Restaurant and Bar. Use social media platforms and company webpages to Promote these businesses, their products, and their technologies, to current and potential customers, at both the B2B and B2B levels.
